subject: Proposal: Graduated discount pathway + milestone voucher for POC
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@windward.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: George Patel <g.patel@windward.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: POC pricing questions and extension options

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for a great demo yesterday. Our leadership wants clarity on two things before we sign the SOW:

1) If we need a one-week extension beyond the 4-week POC, what does that cost? Can that be a credit rather than an invoice?  
2) We want to try the quantized model variant for lower cost — will Redwood allow a fallback to full-precision if quality regresses?

Also attaching a draft SOW. Can Marcus help with a pricing note we can present to our CFO?

Best,
Alicia

[Attachment: Windward_POC_SOW_v1.pdf]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@windward.ai>, George Patel <g.patel@windward.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC pricing questions and extension options

Hi Alicia — really appreciate the thoughtful questions.

Short answers up front:
- One-week extension: we can offer an optional one-week top-up charged as credits (applied to the account) at 75% of the pro-rated weekly POC rate. Credits are non-refundable but transferrable within your account for 90 days.  
- Quantized model variant: supported. We'll provide a compatibility SLA that permits you to toggle back to FP models if quality drops beyond a predefined evaluation set; that fallback path is included with no additional charge during the POC.

Marcus — can you confirm the explicit credit amount and put numbers in a line-item? Alicia/team — would you like the extension as a paid top-up now or as a clause on the SOW?

Thanks,
Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@windward.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC pricing questions and extension options

Thanks — quick numbers here to make the CFO's life easier.

Baseline 4-week POC: $28,000 (includes 3 concurrent sessions, standard KV caching)
Pro-rated weekly rate: $7,000
One-week extension as credits: $5,250 (75% of pro-rated)
Milestone voucher option: we can offer a $2,000 voucher that vests if Windward completes the quality checklist and signs a conversion LOI within 30 days of POC end. Voucher applies to hosted usage for 12 months.

If you prefer to add the one-week clause to the SOW instead of an upfront payment, we can put a 7-day hold on capacity and convert to credits within 72 hours of written request. That clause requires a modest administrative fee of $250 to cover capacity reservation.

I'll attach a short pricing addendum PDF for inclusion.

Marcus

[Attachment: PO_terms.pdf]

From: George Patel <g.patel@windward.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC pricing questions and extension options

Priya/Marcus — this is helpful. Two follow-ups:

1) Can the voucher be split across multiple teams? We may have separate product groups using the POC.  
2) For the 72-hour convert-to-credits clause, what happens if we request the convert and capacity is actually constrained? Any guaranteed fallback?

We prefer credits over invoice if possible — makes procurement smoother for us.

If you can send the pricing addendum and a one-paragraph clause we can insert into the SOW, we'll share with procurement this afternoon.

Thanks,
George
